column1: # Format: <simplified word, 2-4 Han characters><TAB><English gloss, <=4 words, <=24 chars>
# "-" as the gloss removes the word. Each line also applies to the traditional forms of the word
# found in CC-CEDICT. Lines were written by S Key contributors after reviewing the ~3000 most
# frequent words of third_party/open_dictionaries/skey_pinyin.tsv; they fix senses the automatic
# picker chooses poorly and add common compositional words that CC-CEDICT does not list.
# License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (same as the CC-CEDICT-derived glossary they are merged into).
# Additional fixes after reviewing ranks 3000-6000 for long or wrong senses.
# Frequent words whose CC-CEDICT senses are all too long for the key; short glosses by S Key contributors.
# Complete concise definitions for previously truncated or omitted entries.
